integrator-dev.input:
units lj
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p
lattice fcc 0.83
region cell block 0 4 0 4 0 4 units lattice
create_box 1 cell
create_atoms 1 box
mass 1 1
pair_style lj/cut 2.5
pair_coeff * * 1 1 2.5
neighbor 0.3 bin
neigh_modify delay 0 every 1 check yes
velocity all create 0.85 1938472 mom yes rot yes dist gaussian
timestep 0.003
thermo 10
thermo_style custom step atoms temp pe etotal press
fix thermal all nvt temp 0.85 0.85 0.3
run 20
fix ballistic all nve
run 40
